# Interface copy index

<!-- Generated by scripts/ui-copy.mjs. Don't edit this file by hand. -->

This index lists every text the app shows or announces, so the copy can be checked, audited, and updated in one place. It's for agents and contributors, not for people who use the app.

- To update it, run `node scripts/ui-copy.mjs`. `npm test` fails when it's out of date.
- The rules for the copy are in `AGENTS.md`, under "Code conventions" and "Keep the docs in step".
- `{…}` stands for a value the app fills in, such as a card name or a count.
- The extractor reads the source as text. It finds strings by their context, such as `text:`, `aria-label`, `announce()`, and `message()`, and other strings that read like prose. Search the source too before you rename something.

## Where the copy lives

| Copy | Where |
| --- | --- |
| Tooltips | `TIPS` in `src/docs.js`. The nerd mode tooltip is `NERD_MODE_TIP`, and `index.html` repeats it. |
| Help pages | `DOC_PAGES` in `src/docs.js`, shown in the **Help** view. |
| Labels, buttons, hints, messages, and `announce()` text | `src/ui/` and `src/main.js` |
| Page title, header, footer, and the Fan Content notice | `index.html`, `src/config.js` (`APP_NAME`, `FAN_CONTENT_NOTICE`) |
| Error messages from Scryfall requests | `errorMessage()` in `src/scryfall.js` |
| Filter chips and search hints | `filterChips()` and `buildQuery()` in `src/query.js` |
| Explore suggestions and reasons | `src/explore.js`, `src/synergy.js`, and `src/combos.js` |
| Deck check messages | `src/deck-rules.js` |
| Keyword explanations | `src/glossary.js` |
| Sort names, format names, and section names | `src/browse.js` and `src/config.js` |

## Tooltips

| Key | Used in | Text |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `TIPS.nerdMode` | `src/main.js` | Nerd mode shows more details on every card: mana value, power and toughness, set and rarity, release date, price, EDHREC rank, and legality in Standard and Brawl. Cards get smaller, so more fit on the screen. |
| `TIPS.applyPreset` | `src/ui/discover.js` | Replaces the current filters with the filters in this preset. |
| `TIPS.savePreset` | `src/ui/discover.js` | Saves the current filters as a preset, so you can apply them again later. |
| `TIPS.drawMode` | `src/ui/discover.js` | Shows random cards that match your filters. A new draw prefers cards you haven't drawn recently. |
| `TIPS.browseMode` | `src/ui/discover.js` | Lists every card that matches your filters, in the order you choose. |
| `TIPS.openSearch` | `src/ui/discover.js` | Opens this search on the Scryfall website, in a new tab. |
| `TIPS.game` | `src/ui/criteria-form.js` | Shows only cards you can play in this game: MTG Arena, Magic Online (MTGO), or paper. |
| `TIPS.rebalanced` | `src/ui/criteria-form.js` | Leaves out rebalanced cards: digital-only versions that MTG Arena changed for balance. Their names start with A-. |
| `TIPS.colorMode` | `src/ui/criteria-form.js` | How the colors you choose filter cards. Exactly: only those colors. At least: those colors and maybe more. At most: no other colors. Any: no color filter. |
| `TIPS.colorIdentity` | `src/ui/criteria-form.js` | Matches the colors in a card's rules text as well as its cost, the way Commander and Brawl decks are built. |
| `TIPS.typeLine` | `src/ui/criteria-form.js` | Matches words in the type line, such as Elf, Equipment, or Legendary. |
| `TIPS.manaValue` | `src/ui/criteria-form.js` | The total amount of mana in a card's cost. For example, a card that costs {2}{G}{G} has a mana value of 4. |
| `TIPS.keyword` | `src/ui/criteria-form.js` | Matches a keyword ability, such as flying, trample, or ward. |
| `TIPS.rulesText` | `src/ui/criteria-form.js` | Matches words in the card's rules text, such as "draw a card". |
| `TIPS.exportArena` | `src/ui/lists-view.js` | Shows the deck as text to copy and import into MTG Arena. |
| `TIPS.findCombos` | `src/ui/lists-view.js` | Shows the list as text to paste into Find My Combos on Commander Spellbook. |
| `TIPS.openList` | `src/ui/lists-view.js` | Opens every card in this list on the Scryfall website, in a new tab. |
| `TIPS.refresh` | `src/ui/lists-view.js` | Gets current legality, prices, and images from Scryfall. Quantities, sections, and notes stay the same. |
| `TIPS.listKind` | `src/ui/lists-view.js` | A deck gets deck checks and stats for its format. A collection is a plain list of cards. |
| `TIPS.section` | `src/ui/add-panel.js` | Maybe holds cards you're considering, and the Arena export leaves it out. Commander holds a Brawl deck's commander. |
| `TIPS.edhrecRank` | `src/ui/details.js` | How popular the card is in Commander decks on EDHREC. Rank 1 is in the most decks. |
| `TIPS.storage` | `src/ui/data-view.js` | Persistent storage means the browser keeps the app's data even when the device runs low on space. |
